challenge.results: KVIrc has a different grantor context, operative text, entity and revision. Runge permits a modifier to extend the exception or delete it. The x11vnc row explicitly says active. Neither the alternate specimen nor the alternate lifecycle fits.

limitations: The header identifies the release through its wording and the pinned file. It gives no numbered release. Another file, release, modified version, or OpenSSL licensing regime requires its own evidence.

Active records the Index decision to maintain this reference for current lookup. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation, permission for a particular distribution, and authorization to publish a consumer dataset are separate determinations.
